subject: Renewal trajectory: update needed for high-risk accounts
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal trajectory: update needed for high-risk accounts

Team —

Quick hygiene ask as we head into month-end finance scrub. I pulled the weekly renewal sheet and flagged a small set of accounts with ambiguous stages or missing commit dates. Please do the following by EOD Thursday (2027-12-02):

- Update HubSpot stage to the most defensible value (Negotiation / Commit / Closed-won / At-risk).
- For any account you mark Commit, add a committed ARR number and a committed month (MM/YYYY).
- Tag churn drivers on the record (e.g., product fit, pricing, executive sponsor churn).
- Upload any short backup (1–2 slides or notes) to the shared folder and attach in your reply.

Two high-priority items I flagged:
1) Nimbus Retail — $125,000 ARR; renewal window 2028-01-10; current stage shows "Negotiation" but recent exec engagement is unclear.
2) Nebula Analytics — $48,000 ARR; renewal 2028-02-01; prospecting shows soft signal on product usage.

I attached the current renewal_matrix-20271201.xlsx (lightweight) and pulled recent account notes into nimbus_account_notes.pdf for context. If you need me to step into the next customer touch, flag who should own.

Thanks — small ask but important for month close and the forecast call next week.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Renewals Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: renewal_matrix-20271201.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), nimbus_account_notes.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-01T15:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal trajectory: update needed for high-risk accounts

Vanessa — thanks for the heads up. Quick update on Nimbus and Nebula below; I attached a concise snapshot (Nimbus_Renewal_Snapshot.xlsx) with the numbers and supporting notes.

- Nimbus Retail (RINF-4567) — move to Commit (85% probability). Committed ARR: $125,000. Committed month: 01/2028. Rationale: two exec calls last week (CEO + Head of IT) went well; legal has signaled willingness to accept our standard terms pending PO. Remaining risk: billing cadence and a single integration item the customer wants delivered before go-live. Mitigation: AE (Nathan Lowe) scheduled a follow-up on 2027-12-06 to lock PO timing; engineering has a targeted patch for the integration by 2027-12-18. I uploaded the short contract notes and the integration acceptance criteria into the shared Drive.

- Nebula Analytics — remains Negotiation (40%). Usage trend is flat; finance flagged a potential budget re-alloc for Q1. I recommend a customer health play (product-led demo + exec check-in) before we change probability.

Actions taken:
- Updated HS stage for Nimbus to Commit and filled committed ARR + committed month.
- Added churn drivers: billing_timing, integration_gap.
- Uploaded Nimbus_Renewal_Snapshot.xlsx and a one-page note summarizing next steps.

If Ben or Vanessa want to push for an accelerated PO, I can prep a short email template to the CFO.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Renewal Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Nimbus_Renewal_Snapshot.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-02T08:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal trajectory: update needed for high-risk accounts

Got it — thanks Marissa. Two quick asks:
1) Can you confirm whether Nimbus requires net-30 or net-45 on the PO? That affects when Finance recognizes the revenue for the month.
2) If legal is still reviewing standard terms, is there any redline that would push us past 01/10?

I'll loop in Finance for a quick sanity check after we have the PO timing.

— Ben
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-02T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal trajectory: update needed for high-risk accounts

Perfect — appreciate the fast turn. Marissa, thanks for the commit update and upload. Ben — please confirm PO terms and loop Finance (CC finance-ops@redwood.com) so we have revenue recognition clarity.

Next steps (owner / due):
- Ben: confirm PO payment terms and report back by 2027-12-03 EOD.
- Nathan (AE, external): confirm PO submission date in the 2027-12-06 call. (Nathan, copied on original thread via your external address.)
- Marissa: prepare one-slide agenda for the commit-review sync; we'll run a 30-minute canary commit review on 2027-12-05 10:00 PST. Please upload the agenda (commit_review_agenda.docx) and link it in HubSpot.

I'll run the canary review and escalate anything that looks like a drift in forecast. If we see more than two mid-size deals (>$50k ARR) move from Commit back to Negotiation this cycle, I'll request an emergency pipelift with Sales leadership.

Thanks team — small asks, big impact for month close.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Renewals Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: commit_review_agenda.docx (docx stub)
summary: Internal thread coordinating renewal-stage updates and commit confirmation for Nimbus Retail (RINF-4567) and Nebula Analytics. Marissa updated Nimbus to Commit (85%) with committed ARR and month; Ben to confirm PO payment terms; Vanessa scheduled a canary commit review and requested uploads to HubSpot/Drive. Attachments include renewal matrices and a commit review agenda.
